body:
## Pull request overview

Updates ObjectStack Studio’s Vercel deployment to run in **server mode** (Hono serverless function) instead of **MSW-only** mode, aligning Studio’s hosted behavior with real API endpoints and sharing broker-shim logic across runtimes.

**Changes:**
- Switch Studio Vercel config to server mode (`VITE_RUNTIME_MODE=server`, same-origin `VITE_SERVER_URL=""`) and add SPA rewrite that avoids `/api/*`.
- Add Vercel serverless API entrypoint (`api/[...path].ts`) and kernel singleton (`api/_kernel.ts`) using Hono + `@objectstack/hono`.
- Extract the broker shim into `src/lib/create-broker-shim.ts` and update deps (add `hono`, `@objectstack/hono`, and align `@vitejs/plugin-react` to `^5.2.0`).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds Hono + adapter deps and updates resolved versions (incl. plugin-react downgrade). |
| content/docs/guides/deployment-vercel.mdx | Updates Vercel deployment guide to recommend Server mode and document Hono setup. |
| apps/studio/vercel.json | Switches Studio build env to server mode and adjusts SPA rewrites to avoid `/api/*`. |
| apps/studio/src/mocks/createKernel.ts | Reuses extracted broker shim instead of inlining broker logic. |
| apps/studio/src/lib/create-broker-shim.ts | New shared broker shim implementation for MSW + server modes. |
| apps/studio/package.json | Adds `hono` + `@objectstack/hono` and adjusts `@vitejs/plugin-react` version. |
| apps/studio/CHANGELOG.md | Notes the server-mode Vercel deployment changes for the release. |
| apps/studio/api/[...path].ts | New Vercel catch-all serverless function that delegates to the inner Hono app. |
| apps/studio/api/_kernel.ts | New server-side kernel singleton + Hono app factory for Vercel warm invocations. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

The SPA rewrite rule excludes `/api/` but will still match `/api` (no trailing slash) and rewrite it to `/index.html`. That can break requests to the API root (e.g. discovery at `/api` if used). Update the regex to exclude both `/api` and `/api/*` (e.g. negative lookahead for `api(?:/|$)`).

This `vercel.json` example uses a rewrite that excludes `/api/` but still rewrites `/api` (no trailing slash) to `index.html`. Adjust the pattern to exclude both `/api` and `/api/*` so the API root can’t be shadowed by the SPA rewrite.

`bootKernel()` / `getApp()` can race on cold start if multiple requests hit the function concurrently (both see `_kernel`/`_app` as null and initialize twice). Consider guarding with a module-level in-flight Promise (e.g. `_kernelPromise`, `_appPromise`) so initialization is single-flight.

The kernel is already seeded by `AppPlugin` during `kernel.bootstrap()` (it uses `SeedLoaderService` and honors dataset `mode`/`externalId`). Calling `seedData()` again is redundant and uses a simplified insert-only approach. Prefer removing the manual seeding, or reusing `SeedLoaderService` here for consistent behavior.

The deployment guide positions Server mode as production-recommended, but the sample kernel uses `InMemoryDriver`, which is ephemeral on serverless (data resets on cold starts / scale-out). Add an explicit note to swap in a persistent driver (e.g. Postgres) for production deployments.

New Vercel serverless entrypoint isn’t covered by Studio’s existing integration tests (which currently exercise MSW/virtual browser). Add a minimal test that boots `getApp()` (or calls the handler) and asserts a basic endpoint like `/api/v1/discovery` responds successfully in server mode.
